name: Hourvia
author: samsam80

sections.description:
Hourvia is a WordPress timesheet plugin for small teams, tradespeople and businesses that want employees to enter weekly working hours directly on their WordPress site.

Employees use a front-end interface designed for desktop and mobile devices. Each morning and afternoon period can be linked to a job site and a vehicle, and extra interventions can be added when a day includes multiple locations or assignments.

Managers can review submitted timesheets, approve them, request corrections, unlock them when necessary and export records to CSV.

Hourvia Free works without an external service. Timesheet data stays in the site’s WordPress database.

The employee-facing timesheet portal defaults to French so existing French installations keep the same experience after updating. In the Hourvia settings screen, an authorized manager can choose French, English, or the WordPress site language for employee forms. When “site language” is selected, French WordPress locales use French and other locales currently fall back to English.

Main features

  • Front-end weekly timesheet entry.
  • Responsive employee interface for smartphones and desktop devices.
  • Monday-to-Friday week with optional Saturday.
  • Default working hours of 08:00-12:00 and 13:00-17:00, editable by the employee.
  • Separate job site and vehicle for morning and afternoon periods.
  • Additional interventions for days involving multiple job sites.
  • Searchable job-site picker on mobile.
  • Assigned employee vehicle that is automatically preselected.
  • Vehicle directory with name and registration number.
  • Job-site directory with name and optional reference.
  • Bulk import of job sites and vehicles from CSV, TSV, TXT, XLSX, ODS or JSON files.
  • Duplicate detection during imports.
  • Automatic daily and weekly total calculation.
  • Server-side validation and recalculation of submitted hours.
  • One timesheet per employee and week.
  • Employees can view their own submitted timesheets.
  • Timesheets remain editable until approved.
  • Workflow states: submitted, approved and needs correction.
  • Approved timesheets are locked for employees.
  • Status change history.
  • WordPress administration screen for managers.
  • CSV export.
  • Employee portal language setting: French, English or WordPress site language.

Shortcodes

[hourvia_timesheet_form] displays the employee timesheet form.

[hourvia_my_timesheets] displays the current employee's submitted timesheets.<h3>Privacy</h3>

Hourvia stores the information required for timesheets in the WordPress database, including working hours, job sites, vehicles, statuses and associated WordPress users.

Hourvia Free does not send this information to a third-party service.

The site administrator remains responsible for informing users, defining appropriate retention periods and complying with the rules that apply to their organization.
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress, go to Plugins > Add New Plugin > Upload Plugin.
  2. Select the Hourvia ZIP file, install it and activate the plugin.
  3. Hourvia automatically creates the employee pages used to submit and view timesheets.
  4. Assign the Hourvia employee role to employee accounts that should submit timesheets.
  5. Add job sites from the Hourvia job-site administration screen.
  6. Add vehicles from the Hourvia vehicle administration screen.
  7. If needed, assign a default vehicle from each employee’s WordPress user profile.
  8. Managers with Hourvia permissions can review and approve timesheets in the WordPress administration area.
  9. To change the employee-facing form language, open the Hourvia settings screen. French is the default.
sections.faq:
Does Hourvia require another plugin?

No. Hourvia Free works on its own.

Can an employee see another employee’s timesheets?

No. On the front end, employees can only access their own timesheets. Users with Hourvia management permissions can review team timesheets in the WordPress administration area.

Is an assigned vehicle required?

No. It is only used as the employee’s default selection. The employee can choose another active vehicle for a period or an additional intervention.

Can an employee use several job sites on the same day?

Yes. Morning and afternoon can use different job sites, and additional interventions can be added for the same day.

What happens after a timesheet is approved?

The timesheet becomes read-only for the employee. A manager can unlock it or request a correction when necessary.

Can the employee forms stay in French?

Yes. French is the default employee-facing language, including on existing installations after updating to 1.2.9. Managers can switch the employee portal to English or to the WordPress site language from the Hourvia settings screen.

Does Hourvia send timesheet data to an external service?

No. Hourvia Free stores timesheet information in the site’s WordPress database and does not transmit it to an external service.
sections.changelog:
1.2.9

  • Rewrote the WordPress.org plugin description, installation instructions and FAQ in English.
  • Added an employee-form language setting with French as the default, plus English and WordPress site language options.
  • Kept existing French employee portals in French after updating.
  • Localized employee-facing validation messages and mobile job-site picker labels.
  • Audited state-changing requests so they require both the relevant user capability and a WordPress nonce.

1.2.8

  • Improved the mobile timesheet entry interface.
  • Displayed Job Site and Vehicle fields at full width on smartphones.
  • Added a searchable mobile job-site picker.
  • Improved readability of additional interventions on small screens.

1.2.6

  • Added compatibility hooks used by Hourvia Premium employee navigation.

1.2.5

  • Added front-end employee navigation for timesheet entry, saved timesheets and logout.

1.2.4

  • Improved back-office access handling for authorized timesheet managers and Premium pages.

1.2.3

  • Strengthened security checks and database queries reported by Plugin Check.
  • Improved escaping, form validation and database migrations.

1.2.2

  • Improved prepared database queries, date handling and data validation.

1.2.1

  • Strengthened import and CSV export security.
  • Added WordPress and PHP requirements to the main plugin header.

1.2.0

  • Added bulk import for job sites and vehicles from CSV, TSV, TXT, XLSX, ODS and JSON.
  • Added column detection, duplicate detection and invalid-row handling.

1.1.0

  • Added the vehicle directory and default vehicle assignment per employee.

1.0.9

  • Added the job-site directory and job-site selection in timesheets.
